body.x: Seyeon Tech(www.seyeon.co.kr) introduced its IP CCTV solution and "Flex Watch" at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.
"Flex Watch" is the network security solution that is made of IP camera, video server, recorder, IP module, and software.

IP CCTV solution is the system made of IP camera made of 4K camera with 500M or 300M pixel and PTZ and NVR. IP camera's video lag time is 200msec and NVR features 64 channels, full-HD recording, eight slots, and 48TB expandability.
A staff at Seyeon Tech said, "Flex Watch's UI is similar, making it easy to use once learning to use one." It is being exported in the US and Southeast Asia.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
